Glossary / EPS (earnings per share)
Glossary · Fundamentals

EPS (earnings per share) EPS (प्रति शेयर आय)

Net profit divided by the number of shares outstanding.

हिंदी में: EPS (प्रति शेयर आय)

शुद्ध मुनाफ़े को बकाया शेयरों की संख्या से भाग देने पर प्राप्त राशि।

How it is used in the lessons

EPS (earnings per share) = net profit ÷ number of shares.

From Fundamental Analysis

EPS: profit per share, the figure most used in valuation.

From How to Read Quarterly Results

Example: price ₹450, EPS ₹30, so P/E = 15.
